method_notes: Haringey Primary Admissions booklets (Sept 2026 and Sept 2027 entry), community school oversubscription criterion 5 'Distance' and Notes: distance measured in a straight line from the Ordnance Survey address point of the child's home to the Ordnance Survey address point of the school, calculated using the council's computerised mapping system; measurements by alternative systems or to other points are not taken into account. Tie-break within each criterion is home-school distance (same method); identical distances decided by random allocation supervised by an independent body. Community criteria order: LAC/previously LAC, exceptional social/medical, siblings, children of staff, distance. Some schools have a nursery criterion (e.g. Lift Trinity). Eden Primary (free school) and St James CofE (VA) use faith and distance bands; St Michael's CofE N6 uses a points-based faith criterion; Catholic/CofE VA and faith academies set their own criteria (not individually checked). The council's figure is the 'distance (in miles) from school of last child offered a place under distance criterion' on national offer day.

gaps: 2026: only the council web table (community/foundation/VC/non-faith academy schools) was found; the 2026 'Reception Admissions - How offers were made' PDF (which would cover faith and banded schools) was not found by search or the 2025 URL pattern, so 2026 is not_published for Eden, St James CofE, St Michael's N6, Our Lady of Muswell, St John Vianney and the other VA/faith academies (council says contact the school). Eight community/free schools (Alexandra, Brook House, Devonshire Hill, Earlsmead, Ferry Lane, Lea Valley, Lordship Lane, South Grove) are absent from the 2022-2026 cut-off table; they were all-offered in 2024 and 2025 and probably in 2026, but 2026 is recorded not_published because the council doesn't say so. Web table 2026 figures are printed to 3 dp (2022-2025 to 4 dp); 2025/2024 web values match the PDFs. Faith/banded schools: council publishes only partial figures ('contact the school for full details'); Eden and St James values are the distance-band cut-off, St Michael's N6 values are within a points criterion. Faith schools' own measuring methods were not checked; council straight-line method assumed. PAN from the Sept 2027 booklet (2025 offers table showed different 'PAN' for some, e.g. St Mary's CE 60, St Ignatius 60, St Paul's & All Hallows 60). Excluded: junior schools (Belmont Jr, Bounds Green Jr, Campsbourne Jr, Rokesly Jr, South Harringay Jr, St Francis de Sales Jr, St Mary's Priory Jr, St Paul's & All Hallows Jr) and closed schools (Tiverton, St Peter-in-Chains RC Inf; Seven Sisters became South Grove). Postcodes from the Sept 2027 booklet, checked against GIAS (all match). School types from GIAS (several Catholic/CofE schools shown as VA in the booklet are now academies).
